name: aws-powershell-ruby-java-devcontainer
postCreateCommand: cd $CODESPACE_VSCODE_FOLDER && curl "https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip" -o "awscliv2.zip" && unzip -o awscliv2.zip && sudo ./aws/install --update && PWSH_VERSION=7.6.2 && sudo mkdir -p /opt/microsoft/powershell/7 && curl -L "https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v${PWSH_VERSION}/powershell-${PWSH_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.gz" -o /tmp/powershell.tar.gz && sudo tar zxf /tmp/powershell.tar.gz -C /opt/microsoft/powershell/7 && sudo chmod +x /opt/microsoft/powershell/7/pwsh && sudo ln -sf /opt/microsoft/powershell/7/pwsh /usr/local/bin/pwsh && pwsh -NoLogo -Command "Install-Module AWS.Tools.Installer -Force -Scope CurrentUser; Install-AWSToolsModule AWS.Tools.Common,AWS.Tools.S3,AWS.Tools.EC2 -CleanUp -Force"
